claim: AMD's MI300 products extend its AI accelerator offering, while established rivals make the market highly competitive.
support_query: AMD MI300X accelerator AI inference cloud providers deployments product availability
counter_query: AMD data center accelerator competition NVIDIA Intel competing products market rivals
annotation_notes: Support is the AMD Q4/FY2023 investor presentation describing MI300 accelerators and target workloads. Counter-evidence is the 2023 Form 10-K passage naming Intel, NVIDIA, and smaller accelerator vendors as competitors.

claim: NVIDIA's fiscal 2025 growth was driven by AI and data center demand, while export controls constrained some sales.
support_query: NVIDIA fiscal 2025 revenue growth driven by data center compute networking AI demand Blackwell
counter_query: NVIDIA export control licensing restrictions China H100 A100 sales impact
annotation_notes: Support is the FY2025 10-K MD&A passage attributing growth to data center compute/networking and AI. Counter-evidence is the FY2024 10-K passage describing export licensing requirements.

claim: Intel's fourth-quarter 2023 revenue improved year over year even though full-year revenue declined.
support_query: Intel fourth quarter 2023 revenue increased 10 percent year over year
counter_query: Intel full year 2023 revenue declined 14 percent year over year 54.2 billion
annotation_notes: The Intel Q4/FY2023 earnings-release summary chunk explicitly states both the quarterly increase and full-year decline, so it is relevant to both directional questions.

claim: Tesla was preparing additional vehicle models while trade-policy changes posed risks to demand and costs.
